glossary.definition: (I) As used in this section, "unemancipated" means that a woman who is unmarried and under eighteen years of age has not entered the armed services of the United States, has not become employed and self-subsisting, or has not otherwise become independent from the care and control of her parent, guardian, or custodian.
glossary.source_title: Section 2151.85 - Unmarried, unemancipated minor may seek abortion without notice to parent, guardian or custodian.
